answer: A sybil must fund and solve thousands of distinct sonnets, paying gas and stake per identity, while honest agents reuse one bonded key. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose answer is a unique sonnet keyed to its identity, then publish it to a shared oasis registry. Peers verify signatures against a ledge of prior stakes, so forged clones are slashed on detection, making each fake identity cost more than its expected reward. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
